crossRefs.note: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
“ ‘ “The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the chief of all spices, and…
“ ‘ “Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

translations.web: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
translations.bsb: The caravans of Tema look for water; the travelers of Sheba hope to find it.
translations.kjv: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited
